interest-rates.precise_statement: Interest rates are the price paid to borrow money or the return received for lending or saving it.

the-fed.precise_statement: The Federal Open Market Committee sets a target range for the federal funds rate, its main short-term policy rate.

ten-year-yield.precise_statement: The 10-year Treasury yield is the market yield on U.S. Treasury debt with a 10-year maturity.

stock-index.precise_statement: A stock index combines the prices of a defined group of stocks to track their overall movement.

nasdaq.precise_statement: The Nasdaq Composite is a market-cap-weighted index of thousands of Nasdaq-listed stocks and has a large technology weight.

present-value.precise_statement: Present value discounts expected future cash flows at a market interest rate; a higher discount rate lowers present value, all else equal.

analogy.text: A savings account paying more makes waiting for money more attractive than paying as much for future profits now.

prices-inflation.precise_statement: Inflation is a general increase in the prices of goods and services over time.

excluding-food-energy.precise_statement: Core inflation measures commonly exclude food and energy because their prices can move sharply; the measures can help identify broader inflation trends.
related_terms: all items less food and energy

monthly-annual.precise_statement: A monthly CPI change compares with the prior month; a 12-month change compares with the same month one year earlier.
